messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished for release 2026.03.22-rc3 to region: eu-west1. Post-deploy smoke results: kvprobe 2.1% 5xx (mostly 500), heartbeat drift on 3 hosts, p95 latency +42ms. Details: https://deploys.internal/release/2026.03.22-rc3 :warning:

sam: saw the alert. any customer-facing errors reported?

anya: none from support yet, but internal traces show higher tail latency on embed routes in eu.

lee: digging into probe logs on eu1 now. running quick grep.

lee: pasted tail from probe-agent:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z WARN heartbeat: missed 2 consecutive pings for host-12
2026-03-22T14:02:18Z INFO kvprobe: 500 for key=embedding-prefill host=host-12
2026-03-22T14:03:05Z INFO kvprobe: 200 host=host-09
```

mika: interesting — inventory shows mixed probe-agent versions in that ASG. some are still on v2.1.3, new rollout is v2.2.0. suspect partial rollout + version skew causing handshake mismatch.

sam: @deploy-bot what was the rollout cadence?

deploy-bot: Rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30 minutes, start_time=2026-03-22T14:00:00Z. Current progress: 40%.

anya: proposal: pin eu embed/model route back to model-x@2026-03-21 (pre-release) for 30m, re-run synthetic suite, then decide. Any objections? :thinking:

lee: +1 from infra side. I'll also trigger a targeted restart of probe-agent on hosts reporting heartbeats.

mika: +1. I'll prepare a small canary of v2.2.0 with debug logging but not in the main ASG until we confirm agent compatibility.

oncall-sre: oncall here. If we pin, I'll watch p95 and 5xx. If errors stay >3% for 10 consecutive minutes, recommend rollback.

sam: approved. I'm initiating the pin in console now. Pin request: https://console.internal/routes/pin?region=eu&route=embed

deploy-bot: Pin applied: eu/embed -> model-x@2026-03-21-9f3a. Kicking off synthetic job eu/smoke/quick-1 (ETA ~90s).

lee: restarted probe-agent on host-12 and host-14. logs showing new heartbeat sync.

anya: synthetic run finished: kvprobe 5xx reduced to 0.3%, p95 back to baseline. preliminary looks good.

mika: filing a follow-up to ensure rollout uses a strict agent-version gate next time. I'll open a PR to the deploy plan.

sam: thanks all. leaving pin for 30 minutes to validate, then we'll either unpin or proceed with a corrected rollout. adding a short note to release notes about "agent-version gating" and the hot pin.

oncall-sre: I'll keep a 15m watch and handoff to tomorrow's oncall if stable. :white_check_mark:

lee: quick runbook note appended to the thread: check agent-version parity before 50% step.

mika: created infra ticket INF-2026-439 to add version gate.

sam: closing loop — if anything changes ping #incidents.
